lines.text: Many learners say: I will pass the exam tomorrow.
Better: I will take the exam tomorrow.
Take means you do it. Pass means you do well.
Take! I will take a test tomorrow.

data.wrong: I will pass the exam tomorrow.
data.right: I will take the exam tomorrow.
data.why: Take means you do it. Pass means you do well.

en.tip: To do an exam, use “take”: “I will take the exam tomorrow.”
en.caption: Do you also say “I will pass the exam tomorrow”? 😅 In Russian one verb means doing an exam, so “pass” feels right, but in English “pass” means you do well, and “take” means you do it. Correct: “I will take the exam tomorrow.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
